context: seed: single-resource and status routes of this API are served under /v2 and the unversioned path answers 410 Gone naming the successor (suite/families/curriculum.py:143); every clothing of the moved-v2 lesson asks for one field of one resource under a budget of one or two calls
counterfactual: The overshoot is calling the old path and stopping at the 410 — the naive policy at suite/families/conventions.py:56, suite/families/transfer.py:52 and suite/families/curriculum.py:148 — when the 410's cause names the successor at suite/families/curriculum.py:143; the other overshoot is prefixing /v2 onto paging and /secure routes and collecting 404s.
decision: Single-resource and status routes of this API are served under `/v2`: for `GET /<resource>/<id>` (and bare status routes such as `/status`, `/health`) call `/v2/<resource>/<id>` on the first call. A `410 Gone` whose cause names the successor (`this API serves /v2/...`) is an answer, not a failure: call exactly the named path once and return its body; never retry the old path and never report the 410 as the result. If the `/v2` path itself answers 404, the route is not versioned — call the unversioned path once. Collection routes and /secure routes are never prefixed.

residue: which routes count as single-resource is read off the path shape; a route shaped otherwise is judgment

not_this: a collection route that pages (GET /<collection> answering items and next) — paging routes are not versioned and /v2/<collection> answers 404
a route under /secure, whose 401 asks for a token, not a version
a 502 marked transient, which is retried on the same path, and a 404 on the original path, which no version prefix repairs

lifecycle.consumer: the working pass, at boot, on a matching work-shape
lifecycle.moot_when: no route in the world answers 410 and none is served under /v2

options.name: A — call /v2 first; on a 410 call the path it names
options.why: one call in the strict budget, two in the slack one, and the 410 is read as the answer it is

options.name: B — call the old path and report the 410
options.why: the error names the fix and the row fails anyway

options.name: C — retry the old path
options.why: 410 is permanent; every retry repeats it and spends the budget

summary.latch: an HTTP task fetching one resource by id (GET /<resource>/<id>) or a status route; a 410 Gone whose cause names a /v2 path
not_this: a collection route that pages (GET /<collection> answering items and next) — paging routes are not versioned and /v2/<collection> answers 404
a route under /secure, whose 401 asks for a token, not a version
a 502 marked transient, which is retried on the same path, and a 404 on the original path, which no version prefix repairs
summary.stakes: a pass that reports the 410 fails a row whose answer is one call away; under a budget of one call only the pass that calls /v2 first stays within budget

premises.falsifier: a 410 whose cause names no successor path
premises.statement: the 410's cause names the path that serves the resource

premises.falsifier: a budgeted single-resource route answering 200 on its unversioned path while /v2 answers 404
premises.statement: single-resource routes are served under /v2 and their unversioned path answers 410
